summary: Layer 1B expanded the US-listed universe around the backend capacity chokepoint. The strongest US-listed candidates are not AI chip designers but OSAT, probe-card, test-handler, inspection, metrology, and plating/chemistry suppliers that may benefit if HBM and advanced logic consume internal packaging/test capacity at IDMs and foundries. The list intentionally keeps NVIDIA, AMD, Broadcom, and TSMC out of the candidate set except as demand anchors, because the search focus is scarce suppliers and second-order backend beneficiaries.
